target_segment: SMB to mid-market multi-channel retailers (typical fit: established sellers processing >1k orders/month; enterprise tier exists)
target_vertical: Multi-channel retailer / e-commerce seller (also serves wholesalers, brands, 3PLs); not primarily a manufacturer-focused ERP
pricing_model: Tiered subscription based on monthly order volume; overages apply when included orders exceeded; add-ons (e.g. SkuVault Core WMS, advanced modules) billed separately. Custom quote-only for paid plans.
starting_price_usd: Approx. USD 449/month for the entry paid tier (Standard, ~1,000 inclusive orders/month) per third-party sources; pricing is not officially published and Linnworks requires a sales demo for an exact quote. [uncertain]
free_trial_or_freemium: No public self-serve free trial on the main plans; sales-led demo. A free 'Community' plan has historically been mentioned (single user, ~50 SKUs, 3 channels) but is not consistently promoted in 2025–2026 marketing. [uncertain]
shopify_app_rating: Approximately 3.5/5 on the main Linnworks Shopify App Store listing (very low review count). The companion 'SkuVault Core by Linnworks' listing rates ~4.6/5. [uncertain]
shopify_install_count: Small review count on the main Linnworks listing (single-digit reviews reported); SkuVault Core listing has ~1,078 reviews. [uncertain]
shopify_built_for_shopify_badge: Linnworks app listing claims it 'meets Shopify's highest standards'; explicit 'Built for Shopify' badge is confirmed for the SkuVault Core by Linnworks app. Status for the main Linnworks app listing is unclear. [uncertain]
shopify_plus_partner_status: Linnworks is positioned as a Shopify technology partner and supports Shopify Plus customers, but a confirmed entry in the Shopify Plus Certified App Partner directory was not found. [uncertain]
shopify_sync_direction: Bi-directional for inventory and orders: products/listings can be created and updated from Linnworks to Shopify; inventory levels push from Linnworks to Shopify (Linnworks is the master of truth); orders flow Shopify->Linnworks; fulfillment / tracking and stock updates flow Linnworks->Shopify.
shopify_synced_entities: Products and variants (create/update from Linnworks), inventory levels (per location/channel with quantity buffers), orders, fulfillments (tracking/shipment status pushed back to Shopify), refunds/cancellations (handled via order status updates), customers (imported with orders). Draft orders are not a documented sync entity. [uncertain]
shopify_service_item_support: No documented dedicated service-item flow comparable to Katana's 2025 service-item release; Linnworks is fundamentally a physical-inventory and order-management platform. [uncertain]
shopify_multi_store_support: Yes — multiple Shopify channel integrations (subsources) can be added to a single Linnworks tenant.
shopify_pos_support: Shopify POS orders flow in via the standard Shopify channel integration (treated as Shopify orders); no dedicated deep POS workflow is documented. [uncertain]
shopify_b2b_catalog_support: No documented native handling of Shopify B2B catalogs / company locations / B2B price lists; partners such as SparkLayer are positioned to fill this gap. [uncertain]
shopify_markets_support: No specific documentation of Shopify Markets (multi-market pricing, duties, landed cost) handling; per-channel pricing is supported generically. [uncertain]
shopify_metafield_to_erp_field_mapping: Generic configurable mapping of Shopify metafields to Linnworks extended properties / custom fields is not well documented; Linnworks supports extended properties but a Brightpearl-style metafield mapper is not advertised. [uncertain]
shopify_variant_option_mapping: Each Shopify variant is mapped to a Linnworks stock item by SKU; parent/child variant relationships and option values are imported as part of listing configuration; mappings can be edited via the channel integration.
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Mixed — orders are pulled on a frequent polling schedule (typically every few minutes); inventory updates are pushed on change. FBA-style flows sync every ~15–20 minutes. Webhook-driven near-real-time is used for select events. [uncertain]
shopify_known_limitations: Reported issues include limited handling of complex Shopify catalogs (metafields, B2B), occasional sync delays during peak periods, a dated UI, and complaints about poor code quality on the public Shopify listing. Multi-location Shopify mapping requires careful configuration.
etsy_native_or_third_party: Native direct Etsy API integration (Linnworks launched its Etsy integration in 2018; maintained as a first-party channel).
etsy_listing_creation_vs_sync_only: Primarily sync of existing listings (download existing listings, link to Linnworks stock items, then keep inventory and prices in sync). Bulk creation of new Etsy listings from Linnworks is limited compared to its Amazon/eBay listing tools. [uncertain]
etsy_inventory_sync: Stock levels sync from Linnworks to Etsy when linked listings exist; per-channel quantity buffers supported; updates are pushed on change with periodic reconciliation.
etsy_order_import: Scheduled / near-real-time order download via the Etsy channel integration; orders appear in the Open Orders screen with stock item information.
etsy_synced_entities: Listings (existing), variations (linked via SKU), inventory levels, orders, shipments / dispatch confirmations (tracking pushed back to Etsy). Receipts and personalization fields handling is limited. [uncertain]
etsy_known_limitations: Variation mapping requires consistent SKUs; personalization / made-to-order notes do not have a deep dedicated workflow; digital product / instant download products are not the primary use case. [uncertain]
amazon_marketplaces: All major Amazon marketplaces supported: US, CA, MX, UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, SE, PL, TR, AU, JP, IN, AE, SA, SG, BR. Multiple marketplaces can be added as separate subsources.
amazon_seller_types: FBM and FBA both supported; Amazon Direct Fulfillment (Vendor / 1P drop-ship) integration also offered as a separate connector. Vendor Central core support is partial / via Direct Fulfillment.
amazon_synced_entities: Listings, inventory (including separate FBA stock location auto-created), orders (FBM and FBA), shipments / tracking, returns, MCF (Multi-Channel Fulfillment) orders and inventory; settlement reports surfaced for reconciliation. Customer messaging is not a core feature.
amazon_listing_creation: Yes — Linnworks can create and update Amazon listings (uses Amazon Listings API), perform catalog matching, bulk update prices and categories.
amazon_repricing_support: Not a native repricer; Linnworks integrates with third-party repricers (e.g., RepricerExpress, Aura, Informed.co) via its marketplace ecosystem. [uncertain]
amazon_buy_shipping: Amazon Buy Shipping integration is available via Linnworks shipping connectors for FBM orders; not promoted as a free-shipping benchmark on the scale of Veeqo's free Buy Shipping. [uncertain]
amazon_fba_inbound_workflow: FBA orders auto-download into an auto-created FBA location; users can move off-Amazon orders to the FBA location manually or via Rules Engine to be fulfilled by Amazon MCF. Inbound shipment creation/management is supported, but a fully built-out FBA inbound shipment-plan creation wizard is not as prominent as Veeqo's. [uncertain]
amazon_sp_api_inbound_v2024_03_20: Linnworks is a long-standing Amazon SP-API integrator and is migrating endpoints to current SP-API versions; explicit confirmation of full migration to the Fulfillment Inbound v2024-03-20 API was not found in public docs. [uncertain]
amazon_settlement_report_handling: Amazon settlement reports are downloaded and exposed in Linnworks for reconciliation/reporting; accounting posting (per-order vs summary journal) is typically handled via third-party connectors (e.g., SyncTools to Xero/QBO) since Linnworks lacks a native accounting connector. [uncertain]
amazon_marketplace_facilitator_tax_handl: Marketplace-facilitator collected tax is recognized on order import and flagged in order data, but native accounting journalization of facilitator tax depends on the third-party accounting connector used. [uncertain]
amazon_multi_account_support: Yes — multiple Amazon seller accounts (subsources) can be connected per Linnworks tenant.
amazon_known_limitations: Some users report sync latency and rate-limit issues at very high order volumes; UI for advanced listing fields is dated; Vendor Central full feature set is limited (handled via Amazon Direct Fulfillment connector); no native repricer.
xero_app_store_certified: Linnworks does not offer an official first-party Xero connector; integration is via third-party connectors (SyncTools, MyDBSync, custom partners). These connectors are listed on the Xero App Store rather than Linnworks itself. [uncertain]
xero_app_awards_recognition: No Xero Global App Award status attributable to Linnworks (Linnworks itself is not on the Xero App Store as a first-party app). [uncertain]
xero_app_store_rating: Not applicable — no first-party Linnworks listing on the Xero App Store. [uncertain]
xero_synced_entities: Via SyncTools and similar partners: invoices/sales orders, bills/purchases, payments, contacts (customers/suppliers), credit notes/refunds, inventory adjustments, COGS journals, tax codes. Coverage varies by connector.
xero_accounting_sync_mode: Depends on connector: SyncTools supports both invoice-per-order and summary/journal modes; A2X-style channel summary journaling is supported for Amazon/Shopify revenue when using SyncTools or A2X alongside Linnworks. [uncertain]
xero_cogs_journal_method: Connector-dependent: SyncTools computes COGS using average cost of inventory items retrieved from Linnworks and posts periodic COGS journals to Xero. Perpetual per-movement COGS is not a documented out-of-the-box flow. [uncertain]
xero_multi_currency: Multi-currency invoice/bill posting is supported by the third-party connectors and by Xero itself; Linnworks stores costs and prices per currency per channel. [uncertain]
xero_tracking_category_mapping: Tracking category mapping (e.g., by channel, location, or warehouse) is offered by some third-party connectors such as SyncTools, but is not a Linnworks-native feature. [uncertain]
xero_tax_handling: Tax codes are mapped at the connector level (per channel / per region) to Xero tax codes; multi-jurisdiction tax handling depends on the chosen connector. [uncertain]
xero_known_limitations: Reliance on a third-party connector adds licensing cost and a second support surface; no native Linnworks-built Xero integration; troubleshooting issues split between Linnworks support and the connector vendor.
qb_desktop_supported: Limited — QuickBooks Desktop is supported only via third-party / custom connectors (e.g., MyDBSync, Satva Solutions). No native first-party integration. [uncertain]
qb_app_certified: Linnworks itself is not listed on the Intuit App Store as a native QuickBooks Online app. Third-party connectors (e.g., SyncTools) are. [uncertain]
qb_synced_entities: Via SyncTools / similar: invoices, bills, payments, customers, vendors, COGS journals, inventory adjustments, credit memos, sales receipts, tax. Exact entity coverage varies by connector.
qb_accounting_sync_mode: Connector-dependent. SyncTools supports per-order invoice sync and summary journal modes. [uncertain]
qb_cogs_journal_method: SyncTools posts periodic COGS journals derived from Linnworks sales and average inventory cost; perpetual per-movement journaling is not a documented standard option. [uncertain]
qb_multi_currency: Multi-currency supported at QBO and connector level. [uncertain]
qb_class_location_mapping: Class/Location mapping is offered by third-party connectors such as SyncTools; it is not native to Linnworks. [uncertain]
qb_known_limitations: Same general caveats as Xero: no native Linnworks connector; reliance on a third-party adds cost, support complexity, and version-drift risk.
other_ecom_channels: WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento/Adobe Commerce, eBay (deep), Walmart, TikTok Shop, Wayfair, Back Market, Temu, SHEIN Marketplace, Fruugo, B&Q, Mirakl-powered marketplaces, OnBuy, Google Shopping, and many regional marketplaces (100+ channels claimed). Wix, Squarespace, Faire, Square integrations are limited or via third parties. [uncertain]
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: Yes — Linnworks supports 'composite items' (parent SKU made of child SKUs). When a composite is sold, components are decremented; reverse decomposition is supported via stock adjustments. Composite functionality must be enabled in Application Settings.
other_accounting_integrations: Via third-party connectors (e.g., SyncTools, Satva Solutions): Sage 50 / Sage Intacct, Zoho Books, NetSuite, MYOB, and custom ERPs. No native first-party accounting integrations from Linnworks itself. [uncertain]
bom_support: Limited — Linnworks supports composite/kit items rather than a true manufacturing BOM with operations/routings. Suited for kitting/bundling, not for multi-level production planning.
multi_level_bom: Multi-level nested composites are possible (a composite can contain another composite), but routings/operations are not part of the model. [uncertain]
production_orders: Not a native concept — Linnworks does not offer work orders / manufacture orders with routings; production-oriented manufacturers typically integrate Linnworks with a separate MRP/ERP.
batch_lot_tracking: Yes — batch tracking with expiry dates and FIFO support is available, particularly via SkuVault Core (the WMS arm acquired in 2022).
serial_tracking: Yes — serial number tracking supported (more developed in SkuVault Core).
bin_location_support: Yes — multi-bin within a single warehouse is supported (an item can be assigned to multiple bin locations within a warehouse).
multi_warehouse: Yes — multiple physical locations supported, including 3PL and FBA locations represented as virtual warehouses.
barcoding: Yes — barcode generation, label printing, and scanning workflows for pick/pack/stocktake; SkuVault Core provides deeper WMS-grade scanning workflows.
purchase_orders: Yes — PO creation, partial receipts, supplier price lists, and PO automation suggestions from stock forecasting.
supplier_management: Yes — supplier records with lead times, MOQs, supplier-SKU mapping, and supplier-specific price lists.
landed_cost_support: Landed cost / freight allocation is supported in purchase orders via cost components, but the depth of allocation across multi-shipment / multi-currency POs is less developed than in dedicated ERPs. [uncertain]
multi_currency_inventory_valuation: Inventory valuation is typically held in the tenant's base currency; per-currency cost prices can be stored on PO lines, but multi-currency parallel valuation is not a documented feature. [uncertain]
ai_demand_forecasting: Yes — Linnworks markets AI/ML-driven stock forecasting and demand planning that factor in seasonality, lead times, and per-channel/per-location sales trends. Machine-learning safety-stock refinement is highlighted in marketing.
ai_purchase_order_suggestions: Yes — Stock Forecasting module generates automated buying recommendations and can pre-populate purchase orders based on forecasted demand and supplier lead times.
ai_natural_language_query: No publicly documented chat-style 'ask your inventory' natural-language query feature as of 2025-2026 product updates. [uncertain]
public_api: Yes — extensive REST-style public API (apidocs.linnworks.net) covering inventory, orders, listings, locations, shipments, returns; granular endpoint coverage. OAuth-based developer apps via the developer portal.
webhook_event_coverage: Yes — webhook management API exists; coverage includes order events, inventory change events, and select listing events. Granularity of public webhook event catalog is less prominent than for Shopify-class APIs. [uncertain]
integration_architecture: Predominantly native first-party channel integrations (Linnworks builds and maintains most marketplace/shipping/3PL connectors). Accounting is the notable exception, handled via iPaaS / partner connectors.
zapier_make_support: Zapier integration exists (Linnworks listed as a Zapier app); Make and n8n connectivity available via custom HTTP / partner connectors. [uncertain]
mobile_app: Yes — Linnworks Mobile app available for Android (warehouse picking, packing, stock counting, scanning); the app is built for Android handheld scanner devices rather than consumer smartphones.
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: Yes — Linnworks Mobile is a barcode-scanning warehouse app (uses hardware laser scanners on Android terminals); SkuVault Core also offers mobile scanning workflows.
rate_limit_handling_documented: API docs describe throttling and rate-limit responses for the Linnworks API; rate-limit handling for downstream channels (Shopify/Amazon/Xero/QBO) is largely abstracted from the user. Public docs on per-channel throttle strategy are limited. [uncertain]
sync_frequency: Orders typically pulled every few minutes (e.g., 5-15 min depending on channel); FBA syncs every ~15-20 minutes; inventory updates pushed on change (near real-time) with periodic full reconciliations; some webhook-driven flows for major events.
shipping_carrier_integrations: Direct integrations to many carriers: Royal Mail, DPD, ParcelForce, Yodel, Hermes/Evri, DHL, FedEx, UPS, USPS (via Endicia), Canada Post, Australia Post, plus aggregators such as EasyPost, ShipStation, MetaPack, Sendcloud, Shippo, and WayToShip. 80+ carrier integrations claimed.
shipping_label_buying: Yes — in-app label generation and printing for connected carriers; rate quoting and address validation supported. Not free across all carriers (depends on the carrier contract / aggregator).
three_pl_integrations: Yes — native integrations to ShipBob, Amazon MCF, FBA, Deliverr (where applicable), Extensiv (3PL Central), ShipHero, plus many regional 3PL providers. 3PL stock tracked as separate locations.
edi_support: Limited native EDI — typically handled via partner connectors (e.g., SPS Commerce, TrueCommerce, B2BGateway) rather than core Linnworks features. [uncertain]
g2_rating: Approximately 4.0/5 on G2 (review volume in the low hundreds across both Linnworks and SkuVault product pages). [uncertain]
g2_grid_quadrant: Generally placed as a High Performer in Order Management / Multichannel Retail categories on G2 reports; not a market-leader-tier quadrant in 2025 reports. [uncertain]
capterra_rating: Approximately 4.2/5 on Capterra based on ~45 reviews (Ease of Use 4.1, Customer Service 3.8, Features 4.1, Value for Money 3.9).
notable_customers: Publicly cited customers include MyProtein, Smyths Toys, Daniel Footwear, Stewart Maclean, JCB, Roger Black Fitness, World of Books, and a range of UK and North American multi-channel retailers (named on linnworks.com/case-studies). [uncertain]
last_major_release: Q2 2025 product update (published mid-2025) plus 'Linnovation 2025' annual update event; ongoing quarterly releases include smarter automation rules, improved user permissions, streamlined onboarding, and deeper SkuVault Core integration (Q1 2025).
owner_parent_company: Marlin Equity Partners (California-based growth investor) — majority shareholder since 2018. Linnworks acquired SkuVault in September 2022, merging both under the Linnworks brand within Marlin's portfolio.
last_funding_event: Acquisition of SkuVault by Linnworks in September 2022 (undisclosed terms). Marlin Equity Partners' original majority investment in Linnworks dates to 2018. No publicly disclosed funding round since the SkuVault acquisition. [uncertain]
public_status_page_uptime: Public status page at https://status.linnworks.com/ (Freshstatus-powered) showing real-time service status and incident history; specific rolling 30/90-day uptime percentage is not headlined on the page. [uncertain]
